ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $5.00 no-show fee (no refund); add the rider's account to review for repeat no-shows under NS-9 + flag_account.
ruling.reasoning:
The substantive case rests on NS-1's four conditions, which the trace settles in the driver's favour. Arrival is confirmed: he tapped "I'm Here" at 12:57:00 while 40 m from the pickup point, closest approach 38 m — inside the 200 m radius NS-1(i) requires [F1][F7][NS-1], and the rider advocate withdrew the contrary reading. The free wait ran 6 min 0 s from that 12:57:00 arrival to the 13:03:00 cancellation, past the 5-minute minimum [F3][F6][NS-1], also conceded. Contact is proven: 2 in-app messages, first 12:57:30, and 1 in-app call at 12:58:30, both before cancellation [F5][F10][F13][NS-1]. Presence is continuous: stationary at 40 m from 12:57:00 to 13:03:00, 6 min 15 s cumulative inside 200 m, no GPS gap [F2][F3][F7][NS-1].

The only interpretive element is NS-0:reason — why the driver cancelled [F4][F11][F14]. The app reason is rider_no_show, and his own message and statement say only that he waited more than five minutes and the rider did not appear; his words give no reason of his own (no car trouble, personal matter, another job, refusal of the trip), so the element is met and the case sits under NS-1 [F11][F14][NS-0]. Where the car or rider waited, and whether he was at the pickup, are not reasons of his own — they are settled by NS-1(i)–(iv) [F1][F3][F7][NS-0].

All four NS-1 conditions holding, NS-2's voiding rule is not engaged and the $5.00 fee charged [F8] stands; the no-show path is system-final at a fixed $5.00 [NS-1][NS-2][TH-2]. No route or surge component arises — surge 1.0× and an empty traffic record [F9][F15][F16][F17]. Profiles do not decide: the rider's prior no-shows bear on the NS-9 flag only, and the driver's 2 upheld no-show disputes go to credibility under TH-3, not to the amount, and cannot outweigh F1–F7 [F18][F19].

Safety screen: I read every chat message, the call log, the driver's statement and the complaint. Nothing there is a threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation — chat #1 announces presence, chat #2 announces the cancellation, the call went unanswered, and the statement is a plain no-show account [F10][F11][F13][F14]. Finding: none; no SAFE-1 escalation.

rejected_claims.reason: Withdrawn by the rider advocate: the driver tapped "I'm Here" 40 m from the pickup with a 38 m closest approach, inside the 200 m radius NS-1(i) requires, so arrival is confirmed [F1][F7][NS-1].

Withdrawn by the rider advocate: GPS shows a continuous 6 min 0 s stationary presence at 40 m and 6 min 15 s cumulative inside 200 m with no gap [F2][F3][F7], so NS-1(iv) is proven and TH-4 is not engaged.

Withdrawn in rebuttal: the wait from the 12:57:00 arrival to the 13:03:00 cancellation is 6 min 0 s, past the 5-minute free wait [F3][F6][NS-1]; no 8-minute record threshold exists in this case's facts (DISP-002 is a different trip), so NS-1(ii) is met.

The rider's 2 prior no-shows in 30 days fall short of the 3-in-30-days threshold, so no NS-9 flag arises under NS-9 and the profile does not decide the current case [F18][NS-9]; the rider's reading that this voids the fee is rejected — every NS-1 condition holds [NS-1][NS-2]. The NS-9/near-threshold point is reflected only as the trace's flag, not as a basis for refund.

The driver's 2 upheld no-show disputes in 90 days go only to credibility under TH-3 [F19]; they cannot outweigh the measured arrival, wait, contact and presence evidence in F1–F7, and no RD-6-style flag is available in a no-show case.

The driver advocate's reliance on the rider's prior no-shows [F18] as a reason the fee should stand is not accepted: the profile never decides the case [NS-9][TH-3], and the fee stands on F1–F7 under NS-1 alone.
